		int [][] curr = new int[1<<n][1<<n];
		for(int i = 0 ; i < 1<<n ; i++)

		curr[0][0] = 0;

		for(int j = 0 ; j < m ; j++)

			int [][] next = new int[1<<n][1<<n];
			for(int i = 0 ; i < 1<<n ; i++)

					next[i][j] = oo;
			for(int c0 = 0 ; c0 < 1<<n ; c0++)
				for(int c1 = 0 ; c1 < 1<<n ; c1++)
					if(curr[c0][c1] != oo)

						{
							int done = 0;

								if(((1<<i) & c1) == 0)
								{
									int up = i-1;
									int down = i+1;
									if(up >= 0 && ((1<<up) & c1) != 0)
										done |= 1<<i;
									if(down < n && ((1<<down) & c1) != 0)
										done |= 1<<i;
									if(((1<<i) & c0) != 0)
										done |= 1<<i;
									if(((1<<i) & c2) != 0)
										done |= 1<<i;
								}

							next[c1][c2] = Math.min(next[c1][c2], curr[c0][c1] + n - Integer.bitCount(done));

						}
			curr = next;
		}

		int res = oo;
		for(int i = 0 ; i < 1<<n ; i++)
			for(int j = 0 ; j < 1<<n ; j++)
				res = Math.min(res, curr[i][j]);

		System.out.println(n*m - res);
	}
}
